rationale: This 1978 paper examines conventional and nuclear armaments escalation, military research and development, arms limitation diplomacy, and disarmament. It is completely unrelated to household or community water or sanitation service access (E01).
plain_vs_narrow_note: Excluded as completely off-topic (E01: military R&D and armaments escalation) under both narrow and plain readings of Criterion 2.

evidence_quotes.quote: Armaments Dynamic and Military Research and Development
The paper examines the present escalation of armaments, both conventional and nuclear
comes to the conclusion that the most important and most dangerous is the military R&D.
